brian.use_for: warm marketing narration, founder-led brand stories

mark.use_for: product demos, casual B2C, dev-tool walk-throughs

liam.use_for: high-energy app trailers, social ads, hype reels

v3_emotion_tags.[excited]: lift energy, faster delivery — use for hooks, reveals, payoffs
v3_emotion_tags.[serious]: drop energy, weighted delivery — use for stakes, problems
v3_emotion_tags.[upbeat]: warm + bright — use for proof points, customer wins
v3_emotion_tags.[warm]: softer, intimate — use for founder/brand moments
v3_emotion_tags.[confident]: grounded, authoritative — use for claims and CTAs
v3_emotion_tags.[uplifting]: rising tone — use for transitions into solution
v3_emotion_tags.[whispers]: intimate aside — use sparingly for emphasis
v3_emotion_tags.[laughs]: human break — use once max, never on a CTA
v3_emotion_tags.[sighs]: weary acknowledgment — pairs with [serious] for problem framing
